scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm format:check
scripts.runtime:stage: pnpm --filter @amun/pi-runtime deploy --legacy --prod --force apps/desktop/.runtime/pi && node scripts/prepare-runtime.ts && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prod=false
scripts.package: pnpm runtime:stage && pnpm firstmate:stage && pnpm terminal:stage && pnpm database:stage && pnpm auth:stage && pnpm --filter @amun/desktop package
scripts.terminal:stage: pnpm --filter @amun/terminal-runtime deploy --legacy --prod --force apps/desktop/.runtime/terminal && node scripts/prepare-runtime.ts terminal && pnpm exec electron-rebuild -m apps/desktop/.runtime/terminal -v 45.2.3 -w node-pty -f && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prod=false
scripts.database:stage: pnpm --filter @amun/database-runtime deploy --legacy --prod --force apps/desktop/.runtime/database && node scripts/prepare-runtime.ts database && pnpm exec electron-rebuild -m apps/desktop/.runtime/database -v 45.2.3 -w better-sqlite3 -f && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prod=false
scripts.auth:stage: pnpm --filter @amun/auth-runtime deploy --legacy --prod --force apps/desktop/.runtime/auth && node scripts/prepare-runtime.ts auth && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prod=false
